gitCommit.subject: fix(canvas): support drawing objects as frame children (#1531)
gitCommit.body:
fix(canvas): support drawing objects as frame children (#1531)

* chore(codex): add AGENTS guide and product doc skills

* Add AGENTS guide and product doc skills

* fix(canvas): support drawing objects as frame children

Drawings created or dragged inside a Frame are now auto-parented via
parentId and rendered through the Frame's child pipeline, so the layers
panel reflects the correct ordering and labels, and frame-local
coordinates stay consistent during drag/transform.

- DrawingObject gains optional parentId; updateFrameContainment covers drawings
- FrameNode renders DrawingNode children with drag/transform handlers
- gazai-canvas skips top-level rendering for parented drawings and uses the
  shared getOrderedFrameChildren resolver
- DrawingLayer now emits visible: true so contained strokes do not disappear
- Layer tree label lookup extracted to display-name.ts and localized for 'drawing'
- handleDrawingDragMove accepts absolutePosition for frame-local drags

* fix(canvas): keep drawing-in-frame resize handles visible and reactive

Address review findings on top of the drawing-as-frame-child PR:

- Render an external Transformer for the selected drawing child at the
  FrameNode root (sibling to the clip group) so resize handles stay
  grabbable when the drawing overflows the frame, mirroring the
  image-child fix. DrawingNode gains a renderTransformer opt-out.
- Drive the external Transformer's selection memo from selection.selected
  instead of the stable isObjectSelected reference, so handles attach on
  click and detach on deselect without waiting for an unrelated mutation.
- gazai-canvas root render falls back to top-level rendering when a
  drawing's parentId points to a frame that no longer exists, preventing
  permanent invisibility from stale references.
- getOrderedFrameChildren accepts legacy children whose parentId property
  is missing entirely (pre-PR data) and rejects stale entries that
  explicitly claim a different parent.
- Add handleDrawingTransformEnd absolutePosition tests; reuse the existing
  FRAME_CORNER_ANCHORS constant in both DrawingNode transformers.
